Facts:
- “Closer” is a song by the American industrial rock band Nine Inch Nails from their 1994 second studio album “The Downward Spiral.”
- Mark Romanek directed notable music videos including Nine Inch Nails’ “Closer,” Johnny Cash’s “Hurt,” Red Hot Chili Peppers’ “Can’t Stop,” Madonna’s “Bedtime Story,” and Michael and Janet Jackson’s “Scream.”
- “The Hand That Feeds” became Nine Inch Nails’ first top 40 pop radio hit since “Closer” in 1994 and “Hurt” in 1995, and it peaked at number 31 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart.
- The film “We” combines the speech “Come September” with varied video footage and music, mostly electronica and industrial, including music by Curve, Nine Inch Nails, Love and Rockets, Placebo, Massive Attack, and Boards of Canada.
